name: Quickening
overview: Scripture reveals quickening as the divine act of imparting life and spiritual vitality, demonstrated by God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. The Father quickens the dead and calls into existence what does not yet exist, as seen in Romans 4:17 and John 5:21. The Son similarly quickens whom He wills, emphasizing His role in resurrection life. The Spirit is the source of true life, quickening believers and renewing mortal bodies, as expressed in John 6:63 and Romans 8:11. This quickening power sustains God's people, enabling them to call upon His name and rise from depths of trouble, as Psalms 71:20 and 80:18 affirm.
